description: This file 'GSIMReadPlatformServiceImpl.java' is a Java source file implementing the 'GSIMReadPlatformService' interface. It provides methods to query and retrieve data related to Group Savings Individual Monitoring (GSIM) accounts, including mapping JDBC query results to data objects, and fetching account information based on various criteria such as group ID, account number, or account ID. It utilizes Spring's JdbcTemplate for database interaction and includes internal mapper classes for converting ResultSet rows into domain data objects.

classes.name: GSIMFieldsMapper
classes.description: RowMapper implementation for mapping ResultSet rows to GroupSavingsIndividualMonitoringAccountData objects with specific fields for GSIM accounts.

classes.name: GSIMMapper
classes.description: RowMapper implementation for mapping ResultSet rows to GroupSavingsIndividualMonitoringAccountData objects with different fields relevant to GSIM accounts.

classes.name: SavingsAccountSummaryDataMapper
classes.description: RowMapper implementation for mapping account summary ResultSet rows to SavingsSummaryCustom objects, including detailed account and transaction info.
